brief: States what a faculty is needed for, in quality, memory, languages, licence and determinism, and never which model.
detail: The registry resolves a requirement to an implementation and explains its choice. The requirement is a plain record read through Data. Quality, memory, languages, licence and determinism filter the models; the floor is never filtered. Latency and locality are recorded but the registry does not read them yet. A quality bar is checked against the score the registry measured on the golden set, a figure computed by the class and not judged by a person.
